releaseNotes.zh-CN:
- 新增环境快捷切换悬浮窗，可在使用其他应用时搜索并切换已保存环境。
- 改善新版 Android 上位置、Wi-Fi、基站和蓝牙虚拟环境的兼容性与稳定性。
- 减少目标应用中的无线环境兼容冲突，并改善回调、扫描停止和环境切换后的资源清理。
releaseNotes.en:
- Added a quick environment-switch overlay for searching and switching saved environments while using other apps.
- Improved compatibility and stability for virtual location, Wi-Fi, cell and Bluetooth environments on newer Android versions.
- Reduced radio-environment compatibility conflicts inside target apps and improved cleanup after callbacks, scan stops and environment switches.
